fields.before: The admitted scratch-table layout or a fixed region's capacity was exceeded. The run must be admitted with sufficient finite maxima before retrying.
fields.after: The admitted scratch-table layout, a fixed region's capacity or the command-scratch byte cap was exceeded. With resource command_bytes, cap is the configured aggregate byte cap and needed is the aggregate live extent plus the refused growth, saturated to UINT64_MAX only on arithmetic overflow. Raise PINEFORGE_COMMAND_SCRATCH_MAX_BYTES or shrink the run before retrying; the refusal precedes backing changes. Other resources require sufficient finite maxima and retain their existing resource-only arguments.
